summary: All three problems, points and solutions match the pages, but three of the four figure crops are mis-boxed: p1-fig1 swallows the page header and clips the pulley figure, p2-fig1 captures the wrong drawing (the Part II pulley figure instead of the springs figure), and p3-fig1 clips the lower half of the circuit; one typo ('състаени') in problem 1's statement.

defects.description: Crop p1-fig1 [50,100,350,290] starts too high: it swallows the page header and the start of the problem text and clips the bottom of the three-pulley figure (hanging masses m_л/m_д region cut).
Crop p1-fig2 [50,340,350,520] includes leftover bottom of the first figure and body text at the top; the m/2m/E figure itself sits lower and its bottom edge is near the crop boundary.

Crop p2-fig1 [50,400,350,580] shows the wrong drawing — the Part II pulley figure with E arrow — instead of the two-springs-with-κ figure for Problem 2 Part II, which sits near the bottom of page 1 (roughly 790–915 permille vertically).
Crop p3-fig1 [50,50,350,220] clips the circuit diagram: only R_3 and R_x are visible; R_2, R_1 and the battery ℰ below are cut off.
